The map has the 10°N latitude line and the 60° and 70° meridians. The Orinoco River Basin is located in Venezuela and its vicinity, in a low-latitude area north of the equator and near about 10°N. Then reason: The question asks for an analysis of the limitations on water energy development and construction from climatic conditions. Low-latitude tropical areas have strong solar radiation and high temperatures throughout the year, so the main climatic limitation faced by engineering development and construction is scorching high temperature.
